Three Reddit threads in 30 days, none about New York: a Pete Davidson podcast episode discussion, a Kelowna BC date announcement for January, and a jazz thread about a Sheila Jordan; Hacker News was silent, so the Beacon Nov 12 show stands on the festival listing.

Reddit returned four threads in 30 days and every one is a name collision (Jessica Chastain, a Jessica Willis stylist, Jessica Szohr, a Jessica Tisch story); Hacker News was silent, so the NYCC Midtown Nov 17 date stands on the club's own listing with no online signal either way.

No signal in 30 days: Reddit returned two threads that are name collisions (a r/TwoXChromosomes audience-reaction thread and a r/SonyAlpha photography post) and Hacker News three unrelated stories, so the Hard Rock Hotel Nov 13 date rests on the festival listing.
